result.rationale: The patient reports a one-month history of difficulty falling asleep, stress-related work issues, and daytime fatigue without acute red flags (e.g., severe insomnia, functional impairment, or urgent symptoms). This aligns with chronic insomnia criteria requiring ≥3 nights/week for ≥3 months, but the symptom duration is insufficient to meet that threshold. No emergency or same-day urgency is indicated; thus, asynchronous clinician assessment via messaging is appropriate.
